/**
 * @name Subprocess calls in cffi
 * @description Find subprocess calls that could be vulnerable to command injection
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/subprocess-calls
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "run", "Popen", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall()
select call, "Subprocess call that could be vulnerable to command injection if arguments contain untrusted input."

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Potentially dangerous C function calls
 * @description Calls to potentially dangerous C functions that could lead to buffer overflows or memory corruption
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/dangerous-c-calls
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-120
 *        external/cwe/cwe-119
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("ctypes").getMember(["memmove", "memcpy", "strcpy", "strcat", "sprintf", "gets"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("cffi").getMember(["memmove", "memcpy", "string", "buffer"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially dangerous C function call that could lead to buffer overflow or memory corruption if used incorrectly."
findings.hypothesis: Calls to potentially dangerous C functions that could lead to buffer overflows or memory corruption

message.text: Potentially dangerous C function call that could lead to buffer overflow or memory corruption if used incorrectly.
